A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the catalytic domain from the nanI sialidase has been cloned, expressed, purified, crystallized, and its structure is currently being refined to 0.92-A resolution.
the nanI catalytic domain has a molecular mass of 48 kDa, and is 50% identical to the leech enzyme, with 30% of the residues in identical positions.
the crystallization and preliminary crystallographic analysis of a catalytic domain from Clostridial sialidase nanI is reported.
